name: jaws
title: Gripper jaws: the flexures generator on the arm
orientation: Flat on the bed, the leaves upright in their layers: the same outline from the bed to the top, and two posts rising straight from the bed to the servo
description: The flexures kit's gripperJaws in place of the hand-built gripper: the same yoke block and screws, the same SG90 and double horn. Two jaws on parallel guides rest closed on a 1 mm gap; the horn opens them, the springs grip, so it holds with the servo off. Each guide stops both ways on a tongue in its fork. Drawn at rest, the leaves straight.

part.rule: 0 the whole print, 1 the palm with the root blocks and the stops, 2 the upper jaw, 3 the lower: the opening check moves the jaws apart from the palm

width.rule: The print's thickness, and the width of the leaves: the yoke's slot, as the hand-built gripper's

block_x.rule: Half the block in the yoke, along the arm: the hand-built gripper's

bolt_x.rule: Half the spacing of the yoke's two screws, as the pen holder's

base.rule: The root blocks behind the guides, along the arm, and the plate joining them

xs.rule: From the bolts to the horn's axis: the root blocks start at the yoke block's front (the design refuses another value and says which)

leaf_l.rule: A guide's leaves: as short (so as stiff, so as strong a grip) as lets the servo open them 2.1 times over (the flexures model's gripper.servo), and the stop stay within 0.8 of the leaves' strain limit

leaf_t.rule: A leaf's thickness: two lines of 0.42

apart.rule: A guide's two leaves, middle to middle: room for the stop's tongue between them

fillet.rule: The round where each leaf meets a block

bar_in.rule: A bar's inner face from the middle, where the horn's tip pushes

reach.rule: The horn's arm from the axis to the middle of its tip, as ghorn draws it (an estimate there: measure yours)

tip.rule: Half the horn's arm: its tip's round

open_a.rule: The horn's arm fully open, from the jaws' line

rest_a.rule: The horn's arm at rest, its tip on the bar: asin((14 - 2.25) / 18), the flexures model's rest

jaw_from.rule: The jaws begin, from the horn's axis: past its sweep (15.9 mm) and the front post

jaw_to.rule: The jaws end, from the axis

jaw_gap.rule: The gap between the jaws at rest: each jaw grips with its guide's spring times how far the object holds it open, so this sets the sizes held. 2 mm: 50 g twice over from 5.7 mm across, 100 g from 9.4 mm, up to 10.5 mm

stop_close.rule: How far a jaw may be pushed closed before its stop: short of the jaws meeting (1 mm each), and leaving room for the posts between the forks

jaw_at.rule: Halfway along the jaws: the payload's point and the tool's anchor

post_y.rule: Half a post across, under the servo's tabs (12.2 wide): the rear post stands between the forks, which close to 6.73 at their stops (7.58 less 0.85), so 0.83 clear, over a print gap

spine_w.rule: Half the spine down the middle, from the plate to the front post: it carries only the servo's turn (0.11 N m) back to the plate

spine_z.rule: The spine's height: well under the horn's plane, with room for the rounds where it meets the posts

horn_z.rule: The horn's plane: as high as puts the servo's case (4.3 mm above the plane) a print gap clear of the print's top

horn_top.rule: The side of the horn toward the servo

face.rule: The servo's mounting tabs: its case and boss reach down 13.3 mm to the horn (as the hand-built gripper's)

post_f.rule: The front post, from the axis: the case's pocket ahead of the shaft (6.6) and 0.2 of air

post_b.rule: The rear post, behind the axis: the case's pocket behind the shaft (17.3) and 0.2 of air

post_x.rule: Each post along the arm: past its screw by 4 mm

pad_front.rule: The servo's front screw, from the shaft

pad_back.rule: The servo's rear screw, from the shaft

pilot_d.rule: How deep each of the servo's screws goes into its post

clear.rule: The front post's slanted side, clear of the horn's arm at rest

round.rule: Every inside corner the palm adds: block to plate, and spine to plate and posts, in plan and in elevation

arc.rule: Steps round a corner's quarter circle

tol.rule: How near the root blocks must start to the yoke block
